affectedRule: Undo restoration when another combatant occupies the activation-start cell

castle.observation: getup records only undox and undoy. The Undo branch later restores the active character's old underlying cell, assigns charunder from field[undox][undoy], and then writes the active character into field[undox][undoy] without checking whether another combatant now occupies that destination.

playerFacingProblem: A legal intervening position change can make Undo overwrite another combatant's battlefield occupancy and leave actor-position and field state inconsistent.
chosenBehavior: Undo is disabled when the activation-start cell is occupied by another combatant. A submitted command is rejected without changing either actor, the turn, or RNG.
